pkgmetadata.longdescription: GeST (Gentoo System Tool) is a modular, YaST-style system administration tool for Gentoo: a full-screen Textual TUI over a layered core, with all privileged actions routed through a root D-Bus service and gated by polkit. Modules cover software (Portage: search, transactional install/update/remove, USE/keyword/mask editing, @world update, depclean, sync, news), system settings (hostname/timezone/locale), OpenRC services, users and groups, and network interfaces (netifrc).
